item.title: Show HN: Watchfire, an open-source control room for AI coding agents
item.summary: Hey, built watchfire because I wanted a way to run multiple agentsnat the same time without having to click accept permissions. That evolved into a way to do it securely, which then evolved into a spec-based dev approach with tasks. Last addition was to add support to expose watchfire as an mcp server. Would love to get feedback. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49175040 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
